text:
You need a reliable way to capture employee work data, analyze productivity, and present it in a clear tracker that helps you spot trends quickly.

Hi, I’m Mina Castellan, and I have 5 years of experience working with SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization. I can help you build an Employee Productivity Tracker that is organized, accurate, and easy to use for ongoing reporting.

For this type of project, I would approach it in three parts: first, setting up a clean structure for employee details, daily work logs, and any other relevant fields; second, organizing the data so it is easy to update and review; and third, building dashboards and visual reports that make productivity metrics simple to understand at a glance. I’m very detail-oriented, so I focus on making sure the data is consistent before analysis begins.

A relevant example of my work is the Sales KPI dashboard for Marlowe Furniture. I built one Power BI report on a star-schema model that replaced 14 separate Excel sales reports. That consolidation also reduced monthly close reporting from 3 days to 4 hours. This project reflects the kind of structured reporting and performance tracking I can bring to your employee productivity tracker.

I’m comfortable working in Excel for analysis and reporting, and I can use SQL and Power BI when a more scalable reporting setup is needed. I also have experience with data cleaning and visualization, which helps ensure the final tracker is both accurate and practical for day-to-day use.

For your project, I would focus on building a tracker that supports:
- data entry for employee records and daily logs
- clean, organized tables for analysis
- performance metrics that are easy to filter and compare
- dashboards that highlight key productivity insights clearly

I work well independently, meet deadlines, and keep communication straightforward throughout the project. I’d be glad to review your current setup, discuss the best tracking structure, and help you create a solution that fits your workflow.
